english:
Super Kills spawn an Orb of Power for allies.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy.

2 second cooldown between Orb spawns.

source.text:
On Super Kill:
Spawns a Orb of Power for Allies.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.

Incurs a 2 seconds cooldown between Orbs.
